findings.action: Retain candidate and isolate terminology sensitivity in QA. Do not claim unconditional full-roster uniqueness across all plausible corner/beside interpretations; do not edit protected source or infer a new rule.

findings.evidence: The source objective explicitly identifies Pixel's Pickup Tent. Consuming that printed fact, all four edge/eight-neighbour and same-room variants give exactly one roster matching source. F4 genuinely belongs to PickupTent: the room continues down the rightmost F4/F5 corridor. HospitalityRoom is E4,D5,E5,D6,E6,F6. findings.action: KEEP; preserve all printed objective information in any future intake/import. No candidate rewrite justified.

mechanics.standard_rules: Every witness once; all six in distinct rows and columns; only printed statements and visible features. Companion indicates next interview, not guilt.
